feature: DMG Synth VGM reference songs / audible CH Live

scope.source: Original VGM / VGZ bytes under /vgm; single normal-clock DMG direct register logs.
scope.live: CH1–4 in the same read-only editor, On by default; Off freezes all channels, Pause forces audible-position snapshot.
scope.audio: Reference APU borrows one editor AudioContext; unity reference gain -> source balance 0.28 -> one shared Master / monitor.

actualWasm: Direct-APU event render and VgmPlayer render are sample-exact.
Duty / Wave RAM / Noise change only at frame 39690, not frame 39689 despite prefetch.
Pause / CH observation does not advance native state; Resume retains queued PCM.
additionalCoverage: Late reference engine disposal and Code generation fences
Wave RAM / trigger / power-off shadow and event bounds
Files collision-safe raw source save / ZIP round-trip / capacity atomicity
Legacy extraction retained if source save fails or instrument extraction finds no sound

checks: Original VGM / VGZ sources live in /vgm; import, selection and restore do not start audio
Invalid and cancelled file reads preserve the selected source and authored sound
Live follows audible position, not prefetched future writes, through the same editor
Pause freezes all four channels; CH changes and Live Off / On only change observation
The reference APU uses one Master / monitor path; keyboard cannot layer over the song
Code and song ownership are exclusive, including cancelled slow reference initialization
Project reload remains passive; 390px controls fit and Stop / pagehide retire all song sources

checks: Code / Files mount lazily with a usable fallback and no audio
Real Code addresses both Pulse channels, Wave RAM and Noise on the existing APU
Live uses the same read-only controls for all four sent / configured channel views
Apply retains one Code lease and prepared state; Stop invalidates saved nested clients and restores author Wave RAM
Save sound preserves running Code and focus, while a JSON selection remains non-runnable
Software Stop fades the real output to silence and reaches the physical restore fence
Files restore preserves text and selection without creating audio or executing saved Code
Maximize and 390px keep one visible Code editor beside Files without horizontal overflow

limits: Recorded stream plays once; seek, loop repetition and paused audition / Capture are next-stage work.
